-- Which characters, objects and locations the film's approved scenes hold,
-- read BEFORE the sheets are planned so a lead gets a turnaround and a
-- one-scene extra gets nothing. Tags are the segmenter's own answer
-- (`char:` / `obj:` / `loc:`); films made before the tags existed still
-- carry names in Prompt Vizual, which Cast Sheet Prep matches instead.
select s.id, s.scene_order, s.tags, s.visual_prompt
  from hov.scene s
 where s.project_id = $hov${{ $('Receive Batch Input').first().json.Project_ID }}$hov$
   and s.scene_approved
 order by s.scene_order

nodes.name: End Frame?

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ $('End Frame Prompt').first().json.requestBody }}

nodes.notes: Scaffolding only: the picture is never stored, re-hosted or shown. onError is continueRegularOutput on purpose so a failed end frame degrades the scene to start-frame-only instead of taking the batch down.

nodes.name: Judge Motion?
nodes.notes: False = keep the clip without judging it (motionJudge:false, no signed URL, no motion prompt, or the scene has already used its one re-roll).

nodes.name: Motion Sheet
nodes.notes: Railway downloads the Flow clip and tiles one frame per second into a contact sheet, answering with its /output URL rather than the bytes (save=1) so nothing large travels through n8n. Continues on error: no sheet means the clip is kept unjudged.

nodes.name: Motion Judge

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const p = $('Motion Prep').first().json; return { model: 'gpt-4o', temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: p.system }, { role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'text', text: p.ask }, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: $json.url, detail: 'high' } } ] } ] }; })() }}

nodes.notes: detail:'high' unlike Consistency Judge's 'low' — the sheet is a grid of small tiles and 'low' would downscale the whole thing to 512px, which is where the movement lives.

nodes.name: Motion Reroll?
nodes.notes: True = throw this take away and generate another. False = the clip carries on to Download Clip exactly as before, with Extract Video URL's own fields intact.

nodes.name: RG End Frame?
nodes.notes: Both branches reach Submit Video Regen, and both carry the whole Prep Video Regen payload — that node reads $json, so nothing may replace it.

nodes.notes: Scaffolding only — never stored, never shown. Continues on error so a failed end frame degrades the regeneration to start-frame-only rather than stranding the producer's Regenerating state.

nodes.name: RG Judge Motion?
nodes.notes: False = keep the regenerated clip unjudged (motionJudge:false, no signed URL, no motion prompt, or this regeneration has already used its one re-roll).

nodes.name: RG Motion Sheet
